connector.name: doc.page PDF Extraction
connector.registryDescription: Extract PDFs to Markdown, RAG chunks and cited tables; publish tracked Doc Links with read stats.
connector.summary: Hosted at doc.page over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace page.doc, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer dk_live_... API key for higher quotas. Works without it on the free anonymous tier.
